QLabel.name: edids_intro
QLabel.text: Pull from a monitor into the library list below, then use the right pane (Decoded / Raw) for the selected row. Create new profile… opens the wizard in its own window.

QLabel.name: edids_poll_status_label
QLabel.text: Polling watches for monitor changes. Use Pull active / Pull override to snapshot into the library.

splitter.name: edids_body_splitter
splitter.tooltip: Drag the divider: library (readbacks + files) and profile details.

QLabel.name: edids_library_hint
QLabel.text: Imports, wizard profiles, and readbacks from monitors live in one list. Choose the output above before Pull or override actions.

QPushButton.name: manager_refresh_button
QPushButton.tooltip: Reload the monitor list and refresh snapshots in the library.

QPushButton.name: edids_read_active_button
QPushButton.tooltip: Copy into the library what Windows is using now from the display chain (effective view). Select the new row on the right to decode.

QPushButton.name: edids_read_override_button
QPushButton.tooltip: If a Windows EDID override is installed for this monitor, copy that registry layer into the library.

QListWidget.name: edids_list
QListWidget.tooltip: Reusable EDID binaries: imports, wizard-created profiles, and monitor readbacks (hover a row for details).

QPushButton.name: edids_import_button
QPushButton.tooltip: Import BIN, DAT, TXT, or INF into the library.

QPushButton.name: edids_create_button
QPushButton.tooltip: Open the EDID creation wizard in a separate window and save the result to the library.

QPushButton.name: edids_duplicate_button
QPushButton.tooltip: Duplicate the selected library entry before editing.

QPushButton.name: edids_delete_button
QPushButton.tooltip: Delete the selected entry from local storage.

QPushButton.name: edids_export_button
QPushButton.tooltip: Export the highlighted entry to BIN, DAT, TXT, or INF.

QPushButton.name: manager_edit_button
QPushButton.tooltip: Typed editors for the selected monitor's working copy (timings, blocks, product fields).

QPlainTextEdit.name: edids_decoded_box
QPlainTextEdit.placeholder: Human-readable decode of the highlighted file.

QTextEdit.name: edids_raw_box
QTextEdit.placeholder: Raw bytes of the highlighted file.
